name: Notice of Retention Consideration (K-8)
description: Written notice that a K-8 student is being considered for retention, with an invitation to an optional conference explaining the reasons.
deadline: upon a determination that the child is being considered for retention
quote: The parent(s)/guardian(s) of K-8 students being considered for retention shall be notified in writing by the school principal or designee upon a determination that their child is being considered for retention.
